description: Data-driven candidate schema induced from temporal SFT/train labels; test is reported only for coverage, not for selecting concepts.

policy.include_rule: include frequent non-other abnormal concepts by total count, even when mostly negated; exclude normal/negative, technical/acquisition, and device/procedure concepts; include frequent other:* only when it also has enough positive mentions.
policy.measurement_score: secondary only; evaluate measurements only when the corresponding canonical finding is present/uncertain in GT.
